summary.text: Denise D'Angelo Steele is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 10 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Mark Sigrist is also running.
She is an at-large member of the South-Western City Schools Board of Education and a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Denise D'Angelo Steele was born in Columbus, Ohio, graduated from Grove City High School and earned an associate degree from Columbus State Community College in 2004.

In a 2023 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mother of three sons and a stay-at-home mom who owns and operates a small business, volunteers as a youth soccer and basketball coach, and supports the Parent-Teacher Association, from which she received the Helping Hands Award in 2021.
D'Angelo Steele took office on the South-Western City Schools Board of Education on January 1, 2024, and her term runs through December 31, 2027.
She advanced from the Republican primary for the Ohio House on May 5, 2026.
In her 2023 school board survey, she listed academic excellence and enhanced school safety among her campaign messages.
